title: Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/resourceRoleScopes
description: A role an access package grants of a resource of its catalog (accessPackageResourceRoleScope): a group role, an app role of an application, or a site group of a SharePoint Online site. Found by the tuple (accessPackageId, resourceOriginId, role); the GUID name is a label. The resource must be a resource of the package's catalog.

accessPackageId.description: Required: the access package's object id, for example [reference('package').id].

resourceOriginId.description: Required: the catalog resource's originId: the group's or service principal's object id, or the site URL.

role.description: Required: the role. A group: Member, Owner, Eligible Member or Eligible Owner (the eligible roles only for a group onboarded in PIM for Groups). An application: the app role's display name or id (Default Access for an app without app roles). A SharePoint Online site: the site group's display name (for example Contoso Members) or its number in the site.

originSystem.description: AadGroup (the default), AadApplication or SharePointOnline: the origin system of the catalog resource.

permissions.notes: Learn (accesspackage-post-resourcerolescopes, accesspackage-delete-resourcerolescopes, accesspackagecatalog-list-resourceroles): EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All is the least privileged permission. Least privileged role: access package manager of the catalog, or Identity Governance Administrator. Eligible group roles need Microsoft Entra ID Governance and a group onboarded in PIM for Groups. The same roles grant an app role of an application or a site group of a SharePoint Online site; adding the resource to the catalog (catalogResources) is where the resource's own roles are needed. Deleting a role scope removes the role from the people assigned (Graph does not refuse it).
